Weaknesses cite working-capital-intensive operations with gross current assets averaging 250-300 days, bank lines "highly utilized, averaging around 85% for the past 12 months ended May '25", and explicit reliance on "partial support from supplier credit".

Expected default on the upcoming instalment of optionally convertible debentures amounting to Rs 268 crore plus Rs 276 crore YTM premium due 31-Mar-2025, on "poor liquidity and insufficient accruals"; free cash and bank balance of Rs 56.28 crore at 30-Sep-2024; Rs 5,383 crore invested in group companies with poor recovery history; PAT negative Rs 91.53 crore FY24 and negative Rs 217.09 crore 9MFY25. CARE made NO mention of working capital constraints, stretched payables or cane arrears.
